lore.item.intro.water_in_the_lake.1: Silent waves in the little lake.
lore.item.intro.shattered_crystal.1: Part of a crystal, shinning but dying,
lore.item.intro.shattered_crystal.2: waiting for its half in the shadow...
lore.item.intro.shattered_crystal.3: Gain 5 seconds of Regeneration I per enemy affected,
lore.item.intro.shattered_crystal.3.ex: Gain 4 seconds of Regeneration II per enemy affected,
lore.item.intro.essence_of_sakura_feathe: In the water is the frozen feather,
where the beauty has faded away.
lore.item.intro.liquid_gray_stone.2: the mixture keeps all livings away.
lore.item.intro.void_time_water.2: we see dailies of every atom.
lore.item.intro.winter_of_solitude.1: Along with the frozen path falls stars with snow.
lore.item.intro.winter_of_solitude.2: People pass by, leaving trails of solitude...
lore.item.intro.natsumatsuri.1: Boys and girls dance around the campfire.
lore.item.intro.natsumatsuri.2: Fireflies celebrate with angels in the crowd.
lore.item.intro.gravity_core.1: All the memories, from every corner of every dimension,
lore.item.intro.gravity_core.2: became a shard of the universe in the core.
lore.item.intro.gravity_core.3: While landing, pull all enemies nearby to the center.
lore.item.intro.moonlight_vial.1: You can admire the purest moonlight in the vial.
lore.item.intro.wisdom_spirits.1: The voice from the spirits in the vial confused every owner.
lore.item.intro.wisdom_spirits.2: No one has ever tried to understand their mind.
lore.item.intro.riddle_of_the_wild.1: Those voice you can't ignore is corrupting your mind.
lore.item.intro.riddle_of_the_wild.2: In a corner of the night, you'll understand what they expect.
lore.item.intro.riddle_of_the_wild.3: Per enemy affected, you additionally apply Bleed for 10 seconds.
lore.item.intro.riddle_of_the_wild.4: Bleed level equals to enemy amount, capped at level 5.
The princess felt the end of the journey.
All her memories with the girl were fading away,
like her tears, in the river of time...
